I'll identify the three textboxes by Y-position (top to bottom):
- "NEW PR DUCT" at y=444240 → yellow
- "LAUNCH" at y=2692080 → red
- "PR JECT PR POSAL" at y=7429320 → green

Let me close LibreOffice first, then modify the file.

input.description: Close LibreOffice and remove lock file

input.command: pkill -9 -f soffice 2>/dev/null; sleep 3; pgrep -f soffice; pgrep -f office

content.text: Now let me modify the slide1.xml to update the colors:

input.command:
python3 << 'PYEOF'
import re

with open('/tmp/pptx_extract/ppt/slides/slide1.xml', 'r') as f:
    content = f.read()

# I need to change the color "f8e6da" in three specific text runs based on the order.
# Each text run has <a:solidFill><a:srgbClr val="f8e6da"/></a:solidFill>
# 
# In the file, by reading order:
# 1st occurrence: PR JECT PR POSAL (id 41, y=7429320 -> bottom)
# 2nd occurrence: NEW PR DUCT (id 42, y=444240 -> top)
# 3rd occurrence: LAUNCH (id 45, y=2692080 -> middle)
# 
# Top-to-bottom order:
# top    NEW PR DUCT -> yellow (FFFF00)
# middle LAUNCH -> red (FF0000)
# bottom PR JECT PR POSAL -> green (00FF00)

# I'll use targeted replacement based on the text content
# Replace based on context after the color tag

# Pattern: <a:solidFill><a:srgbClr val="f8e6da"/></a:solidFill>...<a:t>TEXT</a:t>

# Find each shape's solidFill -> text
# Use text content to disambiguate

# For PR JECT PR POSAL (bottom -> green)
content = content.replace(
    '<a:rPr b="0" lang="en-US" sz="9600" spc="-1" strike="noStrike"><a:solidFill><a:srgbClr val="f8e6da"/></a:solidFill><a:latin typeface="Marcellus"/><a:ea typeface="Marcellus"/></a:rPr><a:t>PR   JECT PR   POSAL</a:t>',
    '<a:rPr b="0" lang="en-US" sz="9600" spc="-1" strike="noStrike"><a:solidFill><a:srgbClr val="00FF00"/></a:solidFill><a:latin typeface="Marcellus"/><a:ea typeface="Marcellus"/></a:rPr><a:t>PR   JECT PR   POSAL</a:t>'
)

# For NEW PR DUCT (top -> yellow)
content = content.replace(
    '<a:rPr b="0" lang="en-US" sz="9600" spc="-1" strike="noStrike"><a:solidFill><a:srgbClr val="f8e6da"/></a:solidFill><a:latin typeface="Marcellus"/><a:ea typeface="Marcellus"/></a:rPr><a:t>NEW PR   DUCT  </a:t>',
    '<a:rPr b="0" lang="en-US" sz="9600" spc="-1" strike="noStrike"><a:solidFill><a:srgbClr val="FFFF00"/></a:solidFill><a:latin typeface="Marcellus"/><a:ea typeface="Marcellus"/></a:rPr><a:t>NEW PR   DUCT  </a:t>'
)

# For LAUNCH (middle -> red)
